title: Pattern 12: Private Cloud Spanner Graph & Vector RAG Deployment
description: Schema for Pattern 12 Private Cloud Spanner deployment with Vector Search indexing, Spanner Graph schema, dedicated VPC, Serverless VPC Access connector, restricted IAM invokers, and optional Cloud Run serving service.

project_id.description: GCP Project ID hosting Spanner resources.

use_existing_network.description: Whether to use an existing VPC network instead of creating a new one.

network_name.description: Name of the custom VPC network to create if use_existing_network is false.

existing_network_name.description: VPC network ID or self link if use_existing_network is true.

existing_connector_id.description: Existing Serverless VPC Access connector ID if use_existing_network is true.

instance_id.description: Unique ID for the Cloud Spanner instance.

spanner_config.description: Spanner instance regional or multi-regional configuration.

processing_units.description: Compute capacity allocated in processing units (100 to 1000 PUs).

embedding_dimension.description: Vector embedding dimension for documents table.

distance_type.description: Distance metric for vector search index.

enable_vector_index.description: Whether to create the vector search index.

enable_graph_rag.description: Whether to deploy the Spanner Graph schema for Graph-Augmented RAG.

graph_name.description: Name of the property graph created in Spanner Graph.

deletion_protection.description: Whether to prevent accidental database deletion.

allowed_invoker_members.description: List of IAM members permitted to connect to the Spanner database.

enable_cloud_run.description: Enable optional Cloud Run RAG retrieval / generation serving service.

container_image.description: Container image URL deployed to Cloud Run.

labels.description: Resource labels attached to all resources.
